name: The Leak
description: The one voice from outside the room in the game theory videos: whoever leaks the tapes, reading the card at the end. A soft, close woman's voice (voice 3 of the test). Kept by Biku on 2026-10-11. Spoken by Chatterbox from a sample of this Kokoro voice since 2026-10-14, so it is the same person, more alive.
